{{Otheruses|Coruscant Museum}}
The '''Braltzamir Museum of Antiquated Machinery''' was a museum located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained antiquated machinery from throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as study pieces.

One of its famous, or rather, infamous exhibitions was the body of the [[Abominor]] known as the [[Great Heep]], which had been deactivated at least 300 years prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Eventually, the Great Heep had been resurrected and removed from the museum by a team of brilliant students from the [[Imperial Engineers Academy]] under the order of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]].
